main_text.p: Dominum Deum invocet omnis in tribula-tione constitutus. Quisquis enim invoca-verit eum in veritate, salvus erit. Ipsi ergo de-betur benedictio, honor, potestas in secula seculorum, Amen.
main_text.head: CONCIO XX.
Judic. 14.

p.i: Escendens[?] autem Simson in Thimnath, vidit mulierem in Thimnath de filiabus Phe-listæorum. Et ascendens indicavit patri suo atq; matri suæ, dicens: Mulierem vidi in Thimnath de filiab. Phelistæorum: nunc itaq; accipite eam mihi in uxorem. Ad quem autem pater suus atque mater sua: Nunquid non est in filiabus fratrum tuorum, & in omni populo meo mulier, quod tu vadis accipere uxorem de Phelistæis incircumcisis? respondit Simson patri suo: Hanc mihi accipe, quoniam recta visa est in oculis meis. Pater autem eius & mater eius nesciebant, quod à Domino hoc esset, quodq; occasionem quæreret contra Phelistæos, cum illo tempore Phelistæi dominarentur Israeli. Descendit itaq; Simson & parentes

page.notes: The initial is a woodcut D, joined to the first word "Escendens", which is printed "Efcendens"; the first letter is doubtful, so it is marked [?]. The small mark before "Mulierem" and before "Ad quem" is a printed quotation sign and is not transcribed. "quodq;" is doubtful and marked [?] in the word itself as read at its first occurrence, so the word itself is a doubtful reading. The reference "Iudic. 14." is set apart as a verse reference, level 3. "eius" at the foot is a catchword and is placed in bottom_margin, not in the text. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
